shelters.name: Kentucky Humane Society
shelters.description: Kentucky's largest pet adoption agency, founded 1884. In 2024, 5,518 animals found homes with 96% save rate. Largest destination shelter for unwanted animals with Love 120 program serving 35+ counties.

shelters.name: Kentucky SPCA
shelters.description: Formed to combat animal cruelty, neglect and fighting through innovative programs. Goal to reduce and eliminate companion and wild animal suffering throughout region.

shelters.name: Lexington Humane Society
shelters.description: Lexington's primary humane society providing shelter, adoption, and animal welfare services for central Kentucky.

shelters.name: Animal Care Society
shelters.description: Publicly supported no-kill shelter finding safe, loving forever homes for adoptable dogs and cats. Over 17,000 animals have found safe haven.

shelters.name: Louisville Metro Animal Services
shelters.description: Louisville Metro's municipal animal services department providing animal care, control, and adoption services.

shelters.name: No-Kill Louisville
shelters.description: Collaborates with local shelters and rescue groups to reduce euthanasia rates. Offers pet food bank, low-cost spay/neuter, and fostering opportunities.

shelters.name: Bowling Green Warren County Humane Society
shelters.description: One of top Kentucky shelters with 10,000+ intakes annually. Campus includes Hildreth Adoption Center, Hotaling Spay/Neuter Clinic, and Davis/Mosby Center. Best Friends partner.

shelters.name: Owensboro Humane Society
shelters.description: 501(c)(3) charity since 1968, went completely no-kill in 1999. Working to stop abuse, neglect, and overbreeding of local animal population.

shelters.name: Humane Society of Northern Kentucky
shelters.description: Mission to end companion-animal homelessness in Northern Kentucky through education and low-cost spay/neuter programs.

shelters.name: Kenton County Animal Services
shelters.description: Primary law enforcement and animal sheltering agency for domestic animals in Kenton County, Northern Kentucky.

shelters.name: Boone County Animal Care & Control
shelters.description: Receives 3,000+ animals annually. Modern new facility providing humane, compassionate services including adoption, fostering, licensing, and cruelty investigations.

shelters.name: Franklin County Humane Society
shelters.description: Independent 501(c)(3) contracted for animal control by City of Frankfort and Franklin County. Offers adoptions and low-cost spay/neuter. No-kill verified.

shelters.name: Humane Society of Nelson County
shelters.description: Friend of the Shelter organization providing veterinary care for sick/injured animals, plus foster homes for recovery or special care.

shelters.name: AARF - Ashland Animal Rescue Fund
shelters.description: No-Kill Verified shelter serving the Ashland and Boyd County area of eastern Kentucky.

shelters.name: Boyd County Animal Control and Shelter
shelters.description: Established by Boyd County Fiscal Court to safeguard public health, humanely house animals, protect from abuse, and promote responsible ownership.

shelters.name: Kentucky Kitty Cats Inc
shelters.description: No-kill, nonprofit 501(c)(3) helping felines since 2013 through adoption services, access to low-cost spay/neuter, and community outreach.

shelters.name: Logan County Humane Society
shelters.description: Independent 501(c)(3) nonprofit operating in Logan County since 1989. Main goal to improve lives of companion animals.

shelters.name: New Vocations Racehorse Adoption
shelters.description: America's largest racehorse adoption program, rehabilitating and retraining Thoroughbreds and Standardbreds for second careers.

shelters.name: Old Friends Thoroughbred Retirement
shelters.description: Thoroughbred retirement farm providing a permanent home for retired racehorses. Open to public for tours.

shelters.name: Woodstock Animal Foundation
shelters.description: Animal rescue and adoption organization serving the Lexington area with foster-based rescue programs.

notes: Comprehensive collection of Kentucky animal shelters, humane societies, SPCAs, and rescue organizations. Kentucky Humane Society (founded 1884) is the state's oldest and largest animal welfare organization with 96% save rate. Coverage spans Louisville, Lexington, Bowling Green, Owensboro, Northern Kentucky (Kenton, Boone counties), Frankfort, Bardstown, Ashland, and Russellville. Kentucky is also home to renowned equine rescues like New Vocations and Old Friends.
